en.headline: Customs seizes 1.6 million illicit cigarettes in Sham Shui Po crackdown
en.dek: A series of operations from late July to 5 August netted about 1.6 million sticks valued at more than HK$7.2 million and led to 27 arrests, including four South Asian men identified as key members of a local syndicate.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it had broken up a South Asian illicit-cigarette syndicate operating in Sham Shui Po after a series of raids between 23 July and 5 August.

Officers recovered about 1.6 million sticks of illicit cigarettes with an estimated market value of more than HK$7.2 million and a duty potential of about HK$5.3 million. Five storage warehouses, four temporary holding points and three mobile stalls were dismantled.

Twenty-seven people aged 27 to 82 were arrested, comprising 24 men and three women. Among them were 22 local residents, one mainland resident and four South Asian men holding recognisance forms who were described as core members of the group. Customs said the suspects used the dense network of subdivided flats and back alleys in the district to move stock between remote and more crowded storage sites in an attempt to evade surveillance.

A dedicated team of more than 100 officers was mobilised. In parallel street operations, 23 people who bought illicit cigarettes were also arrested and charged. Customs noted that 250 people had already been prosecuted for purchasing illicit cigarettes in the first seven months of the year.

zh.headline: 海關深水埗破南亞裔私煙集團 檢約160萬支私煙拘27人
zh.dek: 由7月23日至8月5日一連串行動檢獲約160萬支私煙，估計市值逾720萬元，應課稅值約530萬元，拘捕27人，當中包括4名南亞裔骨幹。
body: 香港海關表示，已搗破一個活躍於深水埗區的南亞裔私煙集團。行動由7月23日至8月5日期間展開，檢獲約160萬支私煙，估計市值超過720萬元，應課稅值約530萬元。
人員搗破5個儲存倉庫、4個臨時儲藏點及3個流動檔攤，並拘捕24男3女，年齡介乎27至82歲，包括22名本地人、1名內地人及4名持「行街紙」的南亞裔人士，後者被視為集團骨幹。
海關指，涉案集團利用區內舊樓及劏房環境複雜的特點，安排人手在清晨及深夜將私煙由偏遠倉庫運往人煙較稠密的地點儲存，企圖逃避調查。當局早前成立專案小組，動員超過100人由倉庫、搬運至零售各層面進行打擊。
同期街頭掃蕩另拘捕23名購買私煙人士，全部已落案起訴。海關指今年截至7月底，已就購買私煙罪行起訴250人。
